author: Mental Outlaw
description:
In this video I show you how to use Linux in an "ungovernable" way by fetching packages and distro iso's over the I2P darknet.

0:00 Intro to I2P
1:49 Downloading Linux .iso's over I2P
3:32 Configuring Qbittorrent to connect to I2P
7:57 How Artix Linux is resisting age check laws
10:31 How to configure package downloads over I2P
